payload.body: The office caches the filing freeze and the published path index, keyed by the text it is asked with. Four doors in world.mjs ask by "refs/heads/main", which names a different tree after every crossing, so an answer read before main moved is handed back after it, until a read by a real commit evicts it. The 2026-10-07 re-filing (POS-441) changed the freeze, so a stale read would judge a re-filed mark, such as corwin/the-second-chair, against a parent it no longer declares. Expected: the cache follows main.
payload.title: The office's filing cache can answer from before main moved

fields.steps:
1. In a scratch git repo, call frozenFilingAt(repo, "refs/heads/main").
2. Commit a new WORLD/filing-freeze.json.
3. Call it again by the same name: the old freeze answers.
4. Call it once by the new commit's sha, then by name again: now the new freeze answers.
Shown in a scratch repo only. Whether the live office ever served a stale answer was not checked; that needs its logs.
